title: Pushed Simulated InputEventKey does not work
body:
### Tested versions

When pushing to a viewport, or via Input, the Generated key is detected, but not work.




### System information

linux 4.3.stable

### Issue description

In the code there is 2 input generators.

The first one, simulates a mouseclick, and on a populated text, the caret indeed moves to the correct location.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f5b8965-a5a3-4610-aa38-6d1e8a2535e2)

but, the second one, triggers the same as the first one, as the _Input() func is activated, and the input is passed and printed to terminal.

The same exact input is printed if the keyboard "A" is pressed, so, the same input is being recieved.

"InputEventKey: keycode=65 (A), mods=none, physical=false, location=unspecified, pressed=true, echo=false" no matter if simulated or real keypress.
but only the real keypress works.


So, InputEventKey does not works and InputEventMouseClick works? Seens like a bug.




### Steps to reproduce

Run this code on a TextEdit:

```gdscript
extends TextEdit


func _ready() -> void:
	pass # Replace with function body.


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	Input.parse_input_event(event_generator2())
	Input.parse_input_event(event_generator(Vector2(100,100),true))
	pass
	
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	print(event)
	
	
	

func event_generator(coord,press):
	var new_event
	if press != null:
		new_event = InputEventMouseButton.new()
		new_event.button_index = 1
		new_event.pressed = press
		new_event.canceled = false
		new_event.position = coord
		new_event.button_mask = 1
		new_event.double_click = false
	else:
		printerr("MOVENDO")
		new_event = InputEventMouseMotion.new()
		new_event.position = coord
	return new_event

func event_generator2():
	var new_event

	new_event = InputEventKey.new()
	new_event.echo = false
	new_event.keycode = KEY_A
	new_event.pressed = true
	return new_event
```
